anomalies.description: A large, sudden explosion erupts on the left side of the road ahead, producing a massive fireball and rapidly expanding smoke plume that engulfs trees and debris; visible in frames f3 through f8.; A large, sudden explosion occurs on the left side of the road, producing a bright orange fireball and a rapidly expanding smoke plume; debris is visibly ejected outward.

The white van directly ahead is struck by the blast or debris, veers slightly, and is enveloped in fire and smoke; subsequent frames show it continuing forward while burning and emitting sparks/debris, indicating severe vehicle damage and loss of control.

A pickup truck is involved in a violent incident: it is struck or impacted (likely by the explosion), resulting in sustained fire and smoke emanating from its rear/right side; the vehicle remains on the road but appears disabled and damaged throughout the sequence.
A sudden, bright flash and rapidly expanding smoke plume erupt from the right side of the road near a utility pole, consistent with an explosion. Debris is visibly ejected outward in frames f0–f3.

A silver pickup truck is struck or impacted (likely by the explosion), resulting in sustained fire, smoke, and visible damage. The vehicle remains on the road but shows progressive burning and structural degradation through the sequence.

A second distinct flash and localized fireball appear on the right roadside (near the same pole), separate from the initial explosion and ongoing vehicle fire, suggesting a secondary detonation or fuel ignition event.; A sudden, violent explosion occurs near the rear of the silver SUV, producing a bright flash, fireball, and immediate ejection of debris and smoke. The explosion is clearly visible in frame f0 (44.5s) and intensifies in f1 (45.0s).

The silver SUV is involved in a severe incident: it is struck or impacted (likely by the explosion), resulting in loss of control, visible damage, and sustained fire/smoke emission. The vehicle remains on the road but is clearly disabled and burning from f0 through f5.

A secondary explosion or intense fire burst occurs on the right side of the road (near the concrete barrier), visible as a bright orange flash in frames f4 (46.5s) and f5 (47.0s), distinct from the initial SUV explosion.
